name: SigNoz
short: Open-source, OpenTelemetry-native observability platform (APM, distributed tracing, logs, metrics, dashboards, alerts) with a free self-hosted Community edition and usage-based SigNoz Cloud.

plans.name: Self-hosted (Community)
plans.notes: Open-source, self-hosted; full APM, distributed tracing, logs, metrics, dashboards and alerts; you run and scale it; community support via Slack.

plans.name: SigNoz Cloud (Teams)
plans.notes: $49/mo minimum including $49 of usage; then $0.30/GB logs & traces and $0.10/million metric samples; 15-day default retention (configurable up to 1 year); unlimited teammates and hosts; MCP server and Noz AI teammate; SOC2 Type II & HIPAA; chat/email/Slack support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Dedicated cloud, BYOC, or self-hosted enterprise support; volume discounts and annual contracts; SSO/SAML, audit logs, SLA, guided migration, training, and professional services.
